review.why: Guides creative-field resumes: an ATS-safe version plus a designed version, with typography, color and portfolio links.
review.summary: Two-version strategy for creative professionals: an ATS-compatible resume for portals and a designed one for networking and direct sends. Covers design principles, guidance per field (graphic, UX, marketing, writers, photo and video), portfolio integration, checklists, tools and an output template.
strengths: Clear rule for when to use each version
Checklists for typography, layout and color
cautions: Advice only: no template or design files
Tool list (InDesign, Figma, Canva) is generic
Overlaps with design work; the ATS part repeats common resume advice
